mentions.name: Freedesktop local model API
mentions.description: A freedesktop (Linux) API that lets apps and app developers call locally running AI models without having to ship models with each individual app. It currently supports vision, speech, and language use cases, runs sandboxed, and can be used from within sandboxed apps.
mentions.problem: App developers currently need to ship AI models with each app; the API removes that duplication by exposing shared local models, though request throughput is limited without a decent PC.
mentions.audience: App and app developers on Linux desktops, with accessibility use cases highlighted
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a freedesktop (linux) api, that allows apps/app developers to call local models, without having to ship them for each app. Currently with vision, speech and language use cases, all sandboxed and able to run in sandboxed apps.

evidence.value: Working on a freedesktop (linux) api, that allows apps/app developers to call local models, without having to ship them for each app. Currently with vision, speech and language use cases, all sandboxed and able to run in sandboxed apps.
